system.description: The "spring-sword" has a hilt like a regular sword but one to five slender, flexible blades--like a cat-o'-nine-tails made of razor-edged steel. When not in use, an urumi can be coiled around the waist like a belt. This exotic weapon is not widely used in martial arts, but any wielder who doesn't possess the requisite degree of Martial Arts is likely to hurt himself as the blades lash and curl. Botched attacks result in the wielder attacking himself.
